audit.whatIsWrong: Swain's root was attributed to W ('before he can W-root you back', 'his W-root chain') and the ult setup to 'W-invisibility'. wants.you[1] also ends in a garbled non-word, 'cleveraged'.
audit.why: Riot's text: E Nevermove is the wave that returns and roots, then optionally pulls, 850 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s. W Vision of Empire is a 5500-7500 range delayed eye that damages, slows, REVEALS, and grants a Soul Fragment — no root. Neeko's Shapesplitter is a directional clone; the disguise is what hides the Pop Blossom preparation, and it breaks on any immobilizing CC — which is exactly what Nevermove applies.
audit.corrected: Root named as Nevermove with its cooldown, Vision of Empire named as the revealing slow zone, and the disguise credited for hiding the ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff EVEN at 5.5/10 on a 25% lane whose every why describes Swain winning, and a chart that disagreed with the packet on rows 0, 2 and 3.
audit.why: Packet chart is Swain/Swain/Skill/Swain/Skill/Swain/Swain and matches the existing prose exactly — whys[0] says he chunks you with no answer, whys[2] calls level 3 a coinflip, whys[3] says he edges the wave.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2 and 3 set to Swain / Skill / Swain in both layers; difficulty 7/10, carry threat 7/10, diff HARD.

audit.whatIsWrong: The item spike said only that his drain out-sustains you; nothing said to buy anti-heal, despite the itemization line already recommending it.
audit.why: Ravenous Flock heals Swain off Soul Fragments and permanently raises his max health, and Demonic Ascension drains — missingInteractions lists needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated for this matchup.
audit.corrected: First-item spike and whys[5] now name Grievous Wounds and the 650 drain radius.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged "Pop Blossom's" — correct Riot name with a possessive, false positive. The real defect in that same line was the word 'cleveraged'.

edits.before: This is where the lane gets ugly. Swain's W (Vision of Empire) is a delayed AoE that zones your waveclear and catches you if you stand to clear, and his E root sets up his full Q-W combo whenever you over-extend. At 6 your Pop Blossom is your only kill path — set it up from a disguise or W-invisibility so the channel starts unseen, land the stun, then Q. But respect the truth: his E-pull interrupts your ult wind-up, and the moment his R (Demonic Ascension) drain is up, a stun-into-burst that doesn't kill just feeds him your HP bar. Only all-in when his E is down and you've baited it.
edits.after: This is where the lane gets ugly. Vision of Empire is a delayed eye he drops from 5500 range or further — it slows, reveals you and feeds him a Soul Fragment, so never stand still to clear. Nevermove is the real threat: the wave roots on its return, and an immobilize breaks your disguise outright. At 6 Pop Blossom is your only kill path — start it disguised so the preparation stays hidden, land the stun, then Q. Once Demonic Ascension is up, a burst that does not kill just feeds him your HP bar. Only all-in with his 12s E baited and down.

edits.before: Land E (Tangle-Barbs) the instant his E-pull is on cooldown and chain Q re-bloom before he can W-root you back
edits.after: Land E (Tangle-Barbs) the moment Nevermove is down and chain the Q re-bloom before its 12s cooldown returns

edits.before: Set up a disguise/clone ult so Pop Blossom's stun lands before his Vision of Empire W can be cleveraged
edits.after: Set up the ult while disguised so Pop Blossom's stun lands before Nevermove's return can root you

edits.before: Use W (Shapesplitter) invisibility to dodge his E hook and break his line of sight so his R drain falls off
edits.after: Send the Shapesplitter (W) clone to eat Nevermove, then leave the 650 R radius so his drain falls off

notes: Level-chart flip is Medium confidence on win rate alone (25% over only 8 games) but High on the prose: every existing why already described Swain winning those rows, so the chart was contradicting its own text. 'cleveraged' in wants.you[1] was a corrupted string, now replaced.
